# Demo Skills

A collection of agent skills for web animation and motion design.

## Installation

Install a skill with the skills CLI:

```bash
npx skills add exemple-org/demo-skills --skill anim
```

## Full toolkit

The full toolkit ships every skill of the collection, with examples and templates for designers and developers alike.

```bash
curl -fsSL https://exemple.org/install.sh | bash
```

## Compatibility

Works with Claude Code and Cursor. Not tested on Windows.

## License

Each skill folder contains its own license file.
